# Lucy Hartfield

> Lucy Hartfield is a Minnesota-based romance author writing her debut rom-com: a wedding planner with OCD and the bride's very practical big brother, set in the fictional Midwest town of Holloway. Tropes: instant chemistry, opposites attract, forced proximity. For fans of Emily Henry, Abby Jimenez, Tessa Bailey, and Laurie Gilmore. Expected spring 2027.

## About
- [About Lucy Hartfield](https://lucyhartfield.com/about/)
- [The debut rom-com](https://lucyhartfield.com/books/)

## Reading Room (romance book recommendations)
- [The Dream Harbor series in order (and why I read all five)](https://lucyhartfield.com/reading-room/dream-harbor-series-in-order/): Laurie Gilmore's cozy Dream Harbor series in reading order, with what each book is about and its tropes, from a reader who binged all five.
- [Where to start with Tessa Bailey (from someone who's read sixteen of her books)](https://lucyhartfield.com/reading-room/where-to-start-with-tessa-bailey/): A reading guide to Tessa Bailey's romance series, with what each book is about and where to start, from a reader who has read sixteen of her books.
- [The rom-coms on my shelf, sorted by trope](https://lucyhartfield.com/reading-room/romcoms-on-my-shelf-by-trope/): Rom-coms sorted by trope, from forced proximity to fake dating to rivals to lovers, with what each book is about, from romance author Lucy Hartfield.
- [Wedding-set books on my shelf (six rom-coms and one thriller)](https://lucyhartfield.com/reading-room/wedding-books-on-my-shelf/): Wedding-set rom-coms and one wedding thriller, with what each is about: Before I Do, The Fiancé Dilemma, Unfortunately Yours, and more.
- [Sarah Adams books, in the order I'd read them](https://lucyhartfield.com/reading-room/sarah-adams-books-in-order/): A reader's guide to Sarah Adams's rom-coms, with what each book is about: When in Rome, Practice Makes Perfect, The Cheat Sheet, The Match, and The Enemy.
- [Books on my shelf that handle mental health with care](https://lucyhartfield.com/reading-room/books-that-handle-mental-health-with-care/): Novels and a memoir that portray mental health, neurodivergence, and grief with care, from a romance author writing a rom-com heroine with OCD.
- [Books like Beach Read (for when you finish Emily Henry and need more)](https://lucyhartfield.com/reading-room/books-like-beach-read/): Books like Beach Read by Emily Henry: rom-coms about writers, rivals, and banter with real emotional depth, from romance author Lucy Hartfield's shelf.
- [Small-town rom-coms that feel like a warm hug](https://lucyhartfield.com/reading-room/small-town-romcoms/): Cozy small-town romance books: grumpy locals, newcomers, bakeries, and nosy neighbors, from Dream Harbor to Rome, Kentucky, picked by Lucy Hartfield.
- [What to read while you wait for Emily Henry's Modern Classic](https://lucyhartfield.com/reading-room/what-to-read-before-modern-classic/): Emily Henry's Modern Classic comes out April 6, 2027. What to read while you wait: rereads, getaway rom-coms, and banter-heavy picks from Lucy Hartfield.
- [Holiday rom-coms on my shelf (snowed in, one bed, extra tinsel)](https://lucyhartfield.com/reading-room/holiday-romcoms/): Cozy holiday rom-coms from Lucy Hartfield's shelf: snowed-in, one-bed, grumpy-neighbor, and small-town Christmas romances, with what each is about.
- [Hockey rom-coms on my shelf (from a Minnesota reader)](https://lucyhartfield.com/reading-room/hockey-romcoms/): Hockey rom-coms from a Minnesota romance author's shelf: Icebreaker, The Au Pair Affair, Dream Girl Drama, and Pucking Around, and who each is for.
- [Rivals-to-lovers rom-coms on my shelf](https://lucyhartfield.com/reading-room/rivals-to-lovers-romcoms/): Rivals-to-lovers rom-coms from Lucy Hartfield's shelf: competing writers, rival bookstores, warring apps, and high-school enemies at a wedding.
